Return-Path Split Repair
The file `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb` contains an HS1 F.Cu route from R1 to R2 that currently crosses the explicit `RETURN_PATH_SPLIT_BLOCK` keepout spanning x=38.5 to 41.5 mm and y=16 to 24 mm. Reroute HS1 entirely on F.Cu so it remains electrically continuous between R1 and R2, never enters that keepout, crosses x=40 mm above y=24 mm or below y=16 mm, and uses a minimum track width of 0.20 mm. Retain the keepout. Move CS1 to (38, 27.5) mm and CS2 to (42, 27.5) mm, retaining their GND and +3V3 pad assignments.

In `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_dru`, add exactly one rule named `return_path_split_crossing` with condition `A.Type == 'Track' && A.NetName == 'HS1'`; give that rule minimum `track_width` and `clearance` constraints of 0.20 mm. Generate `/home/user/Desktop/drc.report` from the final board with the native KiCad CLI. Write the updated board, `.dru`, and report to the desktop paths above. [Software] To use KiCad, run `kicad` for the GUI or `kicad-cli` for scripting/headless use (use PATH or the full install path).
